scope: Targeted property tests verifying discrete Hodge cochains (DHNF), binary sign-switching (BSS-NF), meron involutive cancellation (MIC-NF), zero-float rational LP duality (ZFNF), and epistemic quotient invariance (EQNF)

properties_verified.details: Verified discrete Hodge decomposition on cycle C_4: composite 1-cochain omega = d0(alpha) + h satisfies exact orthogonality <d0(alpha), h> = 0, divergence-free harmonic flow delta(h) = 0 at every vertex, and invariant cycle circulation 4*k.

Verified binary vertex gauge transformation v in {0, 1}^V on signed Hamiltonian graphs: on cycle-free trees and zero-holonomy graphs, gauge propagation strictly eliminates all negative edge signs, yielding transformed sign +1 on all edges.

Exhaustive verification across all 2^3 = 8 vertex gauge configurations on an odd-negative cycle (holonomy = -1): confirmed that frustration prevents sign elimination, correctly rejecting non-negative gauge existence.

Verified fixed-point-free, weight-preserving, sign-reversing involution I on uncancelled sector S0: algebraic cancellation sum_{x in S0} w(x)*sgn(x) = 0 holds exactly in Q, preserving positive survivor partition function Z_surv > 0.
Verified exact rational LP duality: certified optimal primal and dual vectors achieve exact zero duality gap (c^T x - b^T y = 0) with zero floating-point approximation drift.
Verified that any sub-optimal or perturbed primal-dual pair with strictly positive duality gap (gap > 0) routes strictly to Escalate, never Preserve.
Verified epistemic quotient invariance: perturbations delta lying strictly in the null space of observer measurement operator M (ker(M)) preserve the observed equivalence class identically.
Verified epistemic quotient separation: perturbations with non-zero projection onto the measurement row space resolve strictly to distinct observable classes.
